name: Somalia

fees.name: Somalia eVisa / eTAS (federal, mandatory since 1 Sep 2025)
fees.applies: most nationalities requiring a visa to enter federal Somalia (Mogadishu and other federal entry points)
fees.notes: Official federal eVisa/eTAS portal (etas.gov.so, linked from evisa.gov.so and visa.gov.so) is JavaScript-rendered and blocks automated fetch, so the exact fee could not be read directly off the government page. Secondary sources (embassy-adjacent travel guides, visa agencies) consistently report the official portal fee as $64-$65 USD. Treat amount as best-available-evidence, not confirmed on-page by this crawl.

fees.name: Somaliland Visa on Arrival (Hargeisa and other Somaliland-controlled airports)
fees.applies: travelers entering via Somaliland-controlled checkpoints only; not honored for/by federal Somalia eVisa and vice versa
fees.notes: Somaliland (self-declared, not internationally recognized as separate from Somalia) continues to issue its own visa on arrival, distinct from the federal eVisa. No official Somaliland government fee schedule could be located/verified; amount left null rather than guessed.

free_visa_notes: Somalia has no general visa-free regime; nearly all foreign nationals require a visa, now issued as a mandatory federal eVisa/eTAS (effective 1 September 2025) applied for online before travel via etas.gov.so / evisa.gov.so. No reciprocity/nationality-tiered fee schedule was found published on the official portal. Third-party agents (e.g. evisasomali.com) charge an all-inclusive $94 USD service fee, which is NOT the official government fee and is excluded from the fees array above.
